## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      3 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Aug 9, 2026 - Aug 11, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Ftcjmillfam_, Aug 11, 2026, 1/5: "I downloaded the app about 3 weeks ago and was using the free version. Today I was surprised to find out that my Apple account was charged $35 for a yearly subscription that I did not authorize. I cancelled the subscription and set an email to Finch to try to get a refund as I was not really using the app and was about to delete it. If my husband didn’t check our subscriptions I would have never known they were charging me."
            2. _Lia_31_, Aug 11, 2026, 3/5: "So, I’ve had this app for almost 2 years and my birb is 1 year, 10 months, and for literally all that time everything was great but now, for some reason it keeps glitching really badly and throwing me out of the app or the screen goes completely black and I have to restart my phone. It’s so annoying and I don’t know what this is please fix it. Also diamonds are hard to come by in game please make things less expensive like 900?!"
            3. _cayers223_, Aug 9, 2026, 4/5: "I like the app but to buy Finch plus is way to expensive, the cheapest it can be is49.99."

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      3 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: May 28, 2026 - Jul 15, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _plantguyhome_, May 28, 2026, 1/5: "I was so excited to use this app, even considered premium, but sadly my data gets lost every time after exiting the app for a while. This means everything is gone and I just get an apology over and over. For an app that’s meant to help people (especially ones with special conditions) this felt really frustrating to me and really killed my energy yesterday, as it has happened multiple times just yesterday. If I hatch a new pet I DON’T get the promised 500 currency + the data gets lost again. 🫤 UPDATE: Now I can’t even hatch a new egg, because the App just turns grey. Whenever I try to access the old data the screen goes white for an infinite time. So I can neither log in nor create a new one. It’s just completely broken on Iphone ig."
            2. _I hate. Finch_, Jul 9, 2026, 2/5: "Finch is bad because it I so slow"
            3. _Nirpi_, Jul 15, 2026, 5/5: "I love Finch it is so so so cute! I love that you can dress up the Birbs, and get Micropets, and also get cute items to decorate their home! Also, this is the bug in the app: so I update the game, and then when the update is finished, it goes blank white. Please fix this bug. I LOVE THE GAMEEE!!!"
